title: Initial inert extensions of a simplex to its output colors
statement: Use symmetric operadic families and inert edges of [def-coef-symmetric-operadic-family], joins of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone], and coherent slices of [lem-coef-infinity-slice-right-fibration]. Let $M^\otimes\to T\times N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)$ be a small symmetric operadic family, and let $\tau:\Delta^r\to M^\otimes$ end at $d$ over $(t,\langle s\rangle)$. Let $I=\{1,\ldots,s\}$ be discrete and map $\Delta^r\star I$ to $T\times N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)$ using the projection of $\tau$ and the inert color projections of its last vertex; all new vertices have $T$-coordinate $t$. Form $X=M^\otimes\times_{T\times N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)}(\Delta^r\star I)$, let $\bar\tau$ be the lifted initial simplex, let $X_i$ be the fiber over $i\in I$, and put $J_i=X_i\times_X X_{\bar\tau/}$. Each $J_i$ is a quasicategory with an initial object: one is supplied by any extension of $\tau$ whose last edge $d\to d_i$ is a cocartesian inert lift of the $i$th color projection. Such an extension exists. Here initial means that its mapping space to every object of $J_i$ is contractible. The extension category $J=\coprod_iJ_i$ is empty for $s=0$. The assertion holds for arbitrary $r\geq0$ and imposes no limits or colimits in the fibers.
